risk_of_bias: Does NOT lower (RoB tool assessed minimal) | Serious (-1) | Very serious (-2)
inconsistency: Does NOT lower | Serious (-1) | Very serious (-2) — based on I² and direction
indirectness: Does NOT lower | Serious (-1) | Very serious (-2) — population/intervention/outcome
imprecision: Does NOT lower | Serious (-1) | Very serious (-2) — based on optimal information size + CI
publication_bias: Does NOT lower | Suspected (-1) | Very likely (-2)
plausible_confounding: Raise (+1) if would reduce observed effect
